nativeCommandUnknown: The original operation is unconfirmed. Further commands for the same target are blocked. Current statistics or event state do not prove completion; refreshing will not release this restriction.
sqlResetConfirm: Reset SQL execution statistics for the current tenant?
sqlHint: Statistics cover JDBC calls on this instance, including failed and slow calls. SQL text and parameters are not collected.
clearConfirm: Clear caches for the current tenant?

cacheGovernance.nodeSelectionHint: Statistics belong to the selected process; shared cache counts are not added across nodes.
cacheGovernance.description: Manage this tenant's caches by owner, group and scenario. Protected state is read only. Preview exact targets before submitting work.
cacheGovernance.previewHint: The server rechecks permissions, capabilities and versions. Previewing does not perform cache operations.
cacheGovernance.warmBudget: Up to {page} reads per page, {total} total, averaging {rate} per second. The task reports the actual execution process.
cacheGovernance.logicalOnly: Logical completion, historical node confirmation and current availability are separate. Completion does not prove physical memory reclamation.
cacheGovernance.uncertain: Submission outcome is unknown. Inspect the original task. An explicit retry retains the same request key; avoid duplicate tasks.
cacheGovernance.stillPreview: The original task is still a preview. The earlier submission may still be in flight. Inspect again or retry with the original key.
cacheGovernance.statisticsHint: Redis entries are shared per tenant and region. Hit and load counters belong to this process and must not be summed across nodes. Bytes are estimates.
cacheGovernance.nodesHint: Online means a valid lease. Missing or expired nodes remain unknown or offline.
cacheGovernance.cancelHint: Request cancellation of unfinished work? Completed items remain. An in-flight read may stop at the next checkpoint.
cacheGovernance.taskListHint: Your latest 100 previews and tasks. Inspect item results for failures. Cancellation does not reverse completed items.
cacheGovernance.warmResultHint: Read counts do not prove retained entries. Local warming belongs to the listed process. Uncheckpointed pages may have partially read data.
cacheGovernance.allOnline: All expected process leases are valid
cacheGovernance.notAllOnline: Not all expected processes are confirmed online
cacheGovernance.policyUnavailable: This policy format cannot be edited. Refresh and inspect the current state.
cacheGovernance.resetPolicyHint: Restore deployment policy? This removes the tenant override and invalidates the old cache generation.
cacheGovernance.policyHint: Runtime policy can only tighten deployment limits. Provider and connections change during deployment. Saving requires the original version; conflicts are not overwritten.
cacheGovernance.auditHint: Latest 50 control audit records for this region
cacheGovernance.policyReview: Outcome unknown or version conflict. Your draft is retained. Inspect current policy and audit; no automatic retry or overwrite.

states.FORBIDDEN: Operation or business read permission missing
states.NOT_APPLICABLE_PREWARM: Prewarm has no all-node invalidation proof
states.NOT_APPLICABLE_RESOURCE: Native node operation: inspect item results; no all-node invalidation proof
states.DATA_TARGETS_ONLY: Data regions only; inspect native resource item results separately

failures.AUTHORIZATION_REVOKED: Actor or tenant authorization is no longer valid
failures.TARGET_CHANGED: Region, control or data version changed
failures.EXECUTION_PROCESS_CHANGED: Execution process changed; original node warming is incomplete
failures.APPLY_FAILED: Node state application failed; awaiting retry
failures.NATIVE_RESULT_UNKNOWN: Native effect outcome is unknown; no automatic repetition
failures.TARGET_NODE_UNAVAILABLE: Target process did not start the operation before its routing deadline

cacheGovernance.regionDetailsHint: Inspect isolation, lifecycle and the current observation. Unknown is not zero. Details contain no cache contents or connection secrets.
cacheGovernance.resourceScopeHint: An observation belongs to this process and sample time; it does not establish agreement across nodes.
cacheGovernance.nativeTarget: Execute only on node {node}, process {process}. Other nodes will not substitute.
cacheGovernance.nativeCounts: Removed {affected} entries from cache indexes; observed {remaining} retained after the operation. This does not prove memory reclamation.
cacheGovernance.nativeUnknown: The effect may have occurred or may still be running; its outcome is unknown. It will not be repeated automatically. Inspect the resource state first.
